cover.title: Why Is Car Repair So Expensive?
cover.label: Jan 2020

lines.text: Car repair prices are up 55% since January 2020.
lines.say: Car repair prices are up fifty-five percent since January twenty twenty.

lines.text: In the year to August 2026, BLS data shows repair up 5.2% and car insurance down 5.1%.
lines.say: And in the year to August twenty twenty-six, repair rose five point two percent while car insurance fell five point one.

lines.text: CCC Intelligent Solutions puts the average collision repair at $4,818 in 2025.
lines.say: C C C Intelligent Solutions puts the average collision repair at four thousand eight hundred eighteen dollars in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Why? Cars are packed with cameras and sensors, and CCC says post-repair scans and calibrations are now routine.
lines.say: Why? Cars are packed with cameras and sensors, and C C C says post-repair scans and calibrations are now routine.

lines.text: Each collision fix took 26.7 labor hours on average in 2025, up from 23.0 in 2012 (CCC).
lines.say: Each fix took twenty-six point seven labor hours on average in twenty twenty-five, up from twenty-three in twenty twelve.

lines.text: Median mechanic pay: $24.34 an hour in May 2025 (BLS). Yet 49% of shops PartsTech surveyed in fall 2024 bill $120 to $159 an hour.
lines.say: Median mechanic pay was twenty-four dollars and thirty-four cents an hour in May twenty twenty-five, yet forty-nine percent of shops PartsTech surveyed bill a hundred twenty to a hundred fifty-nine an hour.

lines.text: Example: a $100 repair in January 2020, rising with the BLS index, costs about $155 by August 2026.
lines.say: For example, a one hundred dollar repair in January twenty twenty costs about one hundred fifty-five dollars by August twenty twenty-six.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.ig:
Car repair prices are up 55% since January 2020.
BLS CPI, 12 months to August 2026: repair +5.2%, car insurance -5.1%.
CCC Intelligent Solutions: average collision repair $3,421 in 2020, $4,818 in 2025 (preliminary), with 26.7 labor hours per repair vs 23.0 in 2012.
BLS median mechanic pay was $24.34/hr in May 2025; 49% of shops in a fall 2024 PartsTech survey billed $120-$159/hr.
Sources: BLS, CCC Intelligent Solutions, PartsTech.
News and education, not financial advice.
